name: MARKETING 4 – Veröffentlichen (Instagram)
description: Veröffentlicht freigegebene Marketing-Pakete auf Instagram (Karussell, Einzelbild oder Story) über die Instagram-API und verlängert wöchentlich den Instagram-Zugang.

parameters.query:
UPDATE marketing_posts p SET status = 'in_arbeit', medien_token = md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text), geaendert_am = now()
WHERE p.id = (SELECT id FROM marketing_posts WHERE status = 'freigegeben' AND kanal IN ('instagram_post', 'instagram_story') AND geplant_fuer <= now() ORDER BY geplant_fuer, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
RETURNING p.id AS post_id, p.kanal, p.format, p.matrix_user_id, p.medien_token,
  (SELECT room_id FROM ally_nutzer WHERE matrix_user_id = p.matrix_user_id) AS room_id,
  (SELECT titel FROM marketing_themen WHERE id = p.thema_id) AS titel,
  (SELECT ordner FROM marketing_themen WHERE id = p.thema_id) AS ordner,
  (SELECT paket::text FROM marketing_themen WHERE id = p.thema_id) AS paket,
  ally_token('instagram_token') AS ig_token,   -- Migration 187: verschlüsselt
  coalesce(ally_einstellung('instagram_user_id'), '') AS ig_id,
  coalesce(ally_einstellung('instagram_username'), '') AS ig_username,
  coalesce(ally_einstellung('n8n_oeffentlich'), '') AS n8n_oeffentlich,
  -- Produktname für Meldungen (Stefan 18.10.2026)
  produkt_name() AS produkt_name;
UPDATE marketing_posts SET status = $2::text, post_url = NULLIF($3::text, ''), fehler = NULLIF($4::text, ''), medien_token = NULL, geaendert_am = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, status;

parameters.query:
SELECT z.von AS matrix_user_id, z.token, (SELECT room_id FROM ally_nutzer n WHERE n.matrix_user_id = z.von) AS room_id,
  -- Produktname für die Meldung (Stefan 18.10.2026)
  produkt_name() AS produkt_name
FROM (SELECT ally_token('instagram_token') AS token, coalesce(ally_einstellung('instagram_von'), '') AS von) z
WHERE z.token <> '';

INSERT INTO ally_einstellungen (schluessel, wert, geaendert_am) VALUES ('instagram_token_geprueft', to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), now())
ON CONFLICT (schluessel) DO UPDATE SET wert = EXCLUDED.wert, geaendert_am = now() RETURNING schluessel;
